svg.title: A twin's three layers
svg.desc: Three layers, from top to bottom. Life: what changes, such as schedules, notices, and readings. Meaning: what each place is, who is responsible for it, and what happens there, which only people can give; the network's places, looked after by stewards, are this layer, and the first step starts here. Geometry: the shape of the grounds and buildings, which laser scans and drones can capture.

g.text: what each place is, who is responsible for it,
